# Bankové nástroje pre účtovníkov: jedna Pro licencia pre štyri nástroje

> Bundle page for one Pro licence unlocking four free, client-side ARLing tools that Slovak accountants use for bank files: SEPA pain.001 Doctor, SEPA pain.001 Generátor, camt.053 do Excelu, and Párovač platieb.

Each of the four tools works on its own, for free, with no limits on usage, files, or downloads. This page sells one Pro licence that adds convenience across all four at once: no separate purchase per tool.

## The four tools

- **SEPA pain.001 Doctor** (kontrola pain.001): https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-doctor/. Checks a finished pain.001 XML batch payment file against the bank-specific rules of Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB, and ČSOB before import.
- **SEPA pain.001 Generátor** (Excel/CSV → pain.001): https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/. Builds a pain.001 XML batch payment file from payments pasted or uploaded from Excel or CSV.
- **camt.053 do Excelu** (výpis → Excel): https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/. Converts a camt.053 XML bank statement into a CSV/Excel table with a balance check.
- **Párovač platieb** (párovanie platieb): https://arling.sk/parovac-platieb/. Matches a camt.053 bank statement against a list of issued invoices: paid, unpaid, overpaid.

## What Pro adds (all four tools)

Saved payer profiles, processing several files or accounts at once, column-mapping templates for Pohoda, Omega (KROS), and Money S3 exports, a local history of past processing runs, and priority email support. The free tier of every tool stays fully unlimited; Pro is convenience for recurring monthly use, not a requirement.

## Pricing

9 EUR per month, or 79 EUR per year (saves 29 EUR over paying monthly), VAT included. Checkout runs through Stripe; ARLing s. r. o. sells under Stripe Managed Payments, so Stripe is the merchant of record and emails the invoice automatically. Cancel anytime; a 14-day money-back guarantee applies (andrej@arling.sk).

## How the licence works

One signed licence key (Ed25519, verified client-side with WebCrypto, no server call on ordinary use) is issued after payment and stored in the browser via localStorage. All four tools and this bundle page share the same arling.sk origin, so a key saved on any one of them is already visible to the rest; it can also be pasted manually on a different browser or computer. No account or login required.

## Privacy

No account, no login, no server-side processing of your bank data anywhere in the four tools. The only analytics are anonymous usage counts sent to a self-hosted Umami instance.
